lines.text: The root is Cur! Course, excursion.
Did you know? Cur is Latin for run.
Quick quiz! Which means out plus run?

words.ex: I'm taking an online course in photography.

words.mean: a run out on a trip
words.ex: We went on a day excursion to Ha Long Bay.
